# Steadyline Labs

> Steadyline Labs is an independent lab for ideas. Each idea first comes to life as a lean product, usually mobile because it is the fastest way to real users. We watch how people react, and the ones that resonate grow into full products.

## Products
- Tether Link Utility: https://tetherlinkutility.com/ : share your phone's mobile data with laptops, tablets and other phones. QR setup, no root, no account. Android on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alparslan.tetherlinkutility); iOS coming soon. More detail: https://tetherlinkutility.com/llms.txt
- Bil At!: https://bilat.app/ : a quick-fire trivia game in Turkish. Answer fast, aim true. Android on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.steadylinelabs.bilat); iOS coming soon.
- Fathom Pulse: https://fathompulse.app/ : coming to Android and iOS on January 1, 2027. Details coming soon.
